tasks.subject: Task 1: Split protocol into role slices
tasks.description:
**Goal:** INTEGRATION.md becomes a router over five role-scoped parts under docs/protocol/, bundled byte-identically into the plugin, with CI enforcing a per-part cap and a directory match.

**Files:**
- Create: `docs/protocol/{core,authoring,implementer,controller,project-knowledge}.md`
- Modify: `INTEGRATION.md` (replace entirely with the router)
- Delete: `plugin/anti-tangent-protocol/INTEGRATION.md`
- Create: `plugin/anti-tangent-protocol/protocol/` (bundle copy)
- Modify: `.github/workflows/ci.yml:49-73`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Every section identifier present in INTEGRATION.md at HEAD appears exactly once across docs/protocol/*.md, with identical numbering
- [ ] No prose lost: concatenating the parts yields the same set of non-blank lines as the original
- [ ] INTEGRATION.md is under 2,000 bytes and links to all five parts
- [ ] Every part is under 16,000 bytes
- [ ] `diff -r docs/protocol plugin/anti-tangent-protocol/protocol` is clean
- [ ] The CI job demonstrably fails on an oversized part and on a drifted bundle

**Verify:** `bash -c 'for f in docs/protocol/*.md; do b=$(wc -c < "$f"); echo "$f $b"; [ "$b" -lt 16000 ] || exit 1; done && diff -r docs/protocol plugin/anti-tangent-protocol/protocol && [ $(wc -c < INTEGRATION.md) -lt 2000 ] && echo OK'` -> prints sizes then `OK`
